about: What a better Argus means, as data the lab can check. Drafted 2026-11-14 from the objective page; every value under goal_targets and calibration is a draft until signed_off names who approved it and when. tools/argus_lab.py reads this file; argus_ci.py lab validates it. A metric boundary is emission when the QC changed what a tape records (every tape before it differs) and parser when only an analyser changed (the corpus re-parses every tape with the current parser, so it is not a confound there).

tiers.name: Never visibly broken
tiers.rule: Any hard-gate failure rejects the change, whatever else it improves.

tiers.name: Fair
tiers.rule: The threat comes from play, not from knowledge or aim a player could not have. A fairness fix ships even if it lowers threat.

tiers.name: A real threat at skill 1
tiers.rule: Measured only in human sessions; the lab protects it but cannot prove it.

tiers.name: Moves like a person
tiers.rule: Measured by proxies and by eye.

hard_gates.what: Engine or progs error in the tape
Still 6 s or more while losing health
Still 10 s or more, any cause
Bot world death with no health lost in the 3 s before lava or slime

bot_kills_human_pm.what: Bot kills on the human per minute at skill 1

kill_ratio.what: Human kills on bots over bot kills on the human

lava_deaths.label: health
lava_deaths.cannot_say: lava off dm4 from the corpus index, which counts deaths below z -300; the skeptic recounts lava from hull-0 contents when the BSP is on hand

stalls.label: health
stalls.cannot_say: whether it looked stuck; one cell holding a third of stalls matters more than the total

engages.label: proxy
engages.cannot_say: danger: it counts acquisitions, not kills on the human

goals.label: proxy
goals.cannot_say: contest: selections are not touches, and contested maps read low

avg_speed.label: proxy
avg_speed.cannot_say: anything before 2026-08-29; bots corner faster than people

hazards.label: diagnostic
hazards.cannot_say: behaviour; the throttled count rises with frame rate

metric_boundaries.what: goal completions count consumed pickups, not 32u arrivals (GOAP build)
pursuit holds enemies through sight breaks, so engage events undercount contact against earlier tapes
lava deaths classified by hull-0 contents, not z below -300
the cold-shelf fix: early-match goal and weapon economies before it idled for 20 s
arriving at a pending item no longer counts as a completion
travel distance drops the sample either side of a respawn
telefrags credited to the player who caused them, not to world
